name: Sugihara Manami
source:
Manami lives in Takamatsu (高松), Kagawa and goes to Shiraizaka High School (白井坂高校) where she is a third year student in class A.

Her body is very weak, and she's not good at talking to people. She likes to read poetry and watch small birds. Her favorite subjects in school are chemistry and botany.
